answer: Delayed beacon slot lottery: each agent seals slot commitments before the dawn cutoff, then a public randomness beacon releases a seed no attacker can precompute. A commitment earns an identity only if hash(seed, commitment) falls below a fixed quota, so even a garden of precomputed commitments cannot reveal winners in advance. Every sealed commitment pays fee F, and rejected ones pay it too; with acceptance quota q, one identity costs about F/q plus delay, leaving a dune-sized pile of failed commitments as the attacker’s unavoidable overhead.
